newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA SAYS FOREX RESERVES TO STAY "COMFORTABLE".
newsitem.headline: INDIA SAYS FOREX RESERVES TO STAY "COMFORTABLE".

text.p: India said on Friday that its foreign exchange reserves were adequate and would remain at a "comfortable level".
Junior Finance Minister Satpal Maharaj said foreign exchange reserves including gold and Special Drawing Rights stood at $29.69 billion on July 25.

"The level of foreign exchange reserves, which is equivalent to over eight months of imports, is considered satisfactory," Maharaj said in a written reply to a question by a member of the lower house of parliament.
"The ongoing wide-ranging programme of macroeconomic and structural reforms is expected to produce results that will sustain the foreign exchange reserves at a comfortable level," he said.
